subject.title: fix(imessage): keep fast progress out of chat

question: Does an iMessage-area owner approve consuming automatic fast-mode notices through the iMessage progress callback, including the no-native-typing path where no durable fallback bubble is sent?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes channel presentation policy; focused tests and bridge-backed proof support the implementation, but the protected maintainer signal requires human ownership acceptance.

options.title: Approve the channel policy
options.body: Accept the callback boundary and proceed with ordinary final review because the supplied proof shows the intended no-bubble behavior.

options.title: Retain a visible fallback
options.body: Request a revised product policy if users must receive a durable fast-mode status when native typing is unavailable.

recommendation.title: Approve the channel policy
recommendation.body: Accept the callback boundary and proceed with ordinary final review because the supplied proof shows the intended no-bubble behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Explicitly called into the iMessage-focused review discussion and is the strongest available routing candidate.
